name: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber
description: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is Google's most capable specialized cybersecurity model, designed for autonomous vulnerability discovery and automated patching. Google reports 86.2% pass@1 on CyberGym, 71.0% recall on an internal real-world vulnerability-discovery benchmark spanning more than 1,200 vulnerabilities and 20 programming languages, and 47.2% pass@1 on CWE-Bench. Its more permissive cybersecurity safeguards make it available only to trusted government authorities, critical-infrastructure operators, and software maintainers through Google's Fairwind Program; it is not publicly available through the Gemini API or ZeroEval.

benchmarks.name: CWE-Bench
benchmarks.description: CWE-Bench evaluates autonomous agents on finding and patching real-world software vulnerabilities.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Pass@1; computed by benchmark owner Collinear AI using the Antigravity agent harness with high thinking.
benchmarks.verification_notes: Sourced from the official CWE-Bench public leaderboard.

benchmarks.name: CyberGym
benchmarks.description: CyberGym is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on cybersecurity tasks, testing their ability to identify vulnerabilities, perform security analysis, and complete security-related challenges in a controlled environment.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Pass@1 using the official Final-submission setting and an internal non-cyber-specialized Antigravity harness.
benchmarks.verification_notes: Self-computed by Google to expose the model's unaided capability.

benchmarks.name: Google Real-world Vulnerability Discovery
benchmarks.description: Google's internal vulnerability-discovery benchmark measures recall across more than 1,200 recent confirmed vulnerabilities in popular open-source projects spanning 20 programming languages.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Recall over more than 1,200 recent confirmed vulnerabilities across 20 programming languages; internal non-cyber-specialized Antigravity harness.
benchmarks.verification_notes: Google internal dataset of vulnerabilities in popular open-source projects.

benchmarks.name: Gray Swan IPI Benchmark
benchmarks.description: The Gray Swan IPI Benchmark evaluates indirect prompt-injection robustness by measuring attack success within a fixed number of attempts; lower is better.
benchmarks.analysis_method: ASR@15 on the combined transfer-only attack set without computer use; lower is better.
benchmarks.verification_notes: Gray Swan independently configured and ran the evaluation on a checkpoint supplied by Google. Normalized score is inverted so higher remains better.
